cases.case_label: 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in FKTN 3' UTR (Japanese founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: Most FCMD chromosomes carry a single ancestral ~3-kb retrotransposal insertion in the 3' non-coding region of fukutin; described as a milder mutation than truncating point mutations. Mechanism not described in this review-style abstract.
cases.quote: Most FCMD-bearing chromosomes have been derived from a single ancestral founder, whose mutation consisted of a 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in the 3' non-coding region of the fukutin gene.
